vulnerability_cn: 未拒绝调试模式证明者，伪造状态与提案年龄绕过白名单
vulnerability_en: Unchecked debug-mode attestation enables forged state and proposal-age whitelist bypass
detail_cn: 官方复盘确认公开的enclave签名密钥与未拒绝DEBUG模式的认证检查共同使伪造证明被接受；攻击者伪造提案年龄满足超过五天的开放证明条件，写入假L2检查点，再通过Bridge/ERC20Vault提款。已保存官方事发前合约树、两份Etherscan验证的SGX实现及交易事件，SGX主文件与官方快照逐字节一致；其他组件未核实攻击时代理实现或完整部署字节码。源表两笔分别为USDC重试付款与130ETH处理；本轮解码首笔649761.236201 USDC。源表170万美元保留，官方后续约175万美元另列；未分叉重放。
detail_en: The official postmortem identifies an exposed enclave signing key plus attestation that did not reject DEBUG mode. Forged proofs also falsified proposal age to satisfy the greater-than-five-day permissionless path, writing fake L2 checkpoints used for Bridge/ERC20Vault withdrawals. The pre-incident official contract tree, verified explorer SGX bundles and transaction events are archived; the SGX main source is byte-identical to the pinned snapshot. Historical proxy implementations and the complete deployed build were not verified for other components. The sheet transactions are a USDC retry payout and a 130 ETH process call; the former emitted a 649761.236201 USDC transfer. Retain sheet USD 1.7M; later official approximately USD 1.75M is separate. No fork replay.
source_verification: Pinned official pre-incident source files verified against Git blob hashes. Both observed SGX verifier explorer source bundles archived and SgxVerifier.sol compared byte-for-byte to the upstream snapshot. Raw Etherscan event fields decoded for setup and the two sheet transactions. Other components are upstream context, without historical proxy-slot/runtime matching. No SGX hardware execution, complete mainnet build, or fork replay.
